Liquid Glass, Limestone Mass, Pristine Glass, Cromlech Bricks and Condensed Vortex at level 100.
Hourglass level 2: every upgrade in the first upgrade row maxed.
Hourglass level 3 (Timeline open) and the first timeline reset done.

tables.title: Hourglass rules
rows: Each newer generator makes the older ones obsolete; put sand into the latest. Generator speed doubles at levels 25, 50, 100, 200, 300 and so on.

Sandstone Sample, Glass Sample, Water Sample, Clay Block, Bit of Knowledge, Liquid Glass, Limestone Mass, Pristine Glass, Cromlech Bricks, Condensed Vortex, Sol Essence, Locked Orery, Golden Bit, Golden Scales, Golden Claw.
Buy and max every upgrade in a tier before the next. A timeline reset also resets upgrades. Timeline engine gains matter most.
Reset as soon as the Timeline opens and spend the first 10 infinity on three upgrades.
Once open, Rifts outpace engine gains.
Generator Speed first; until Hourglass level 3 it is the only gem upgrade that does anything. Then Timeline Engine, Awakening Amplifier, Rift Worker.
The Bandiff card multiplies sand generation and the Beetleman card the timeline engine.
Time-skip hourglass items cannot be used in Act 3 until its final boss exists and is beaten.
EvitaniaOnlineDB lists sand for levels 2 to 8 as 1e9, 1e15, 1e24, 1e36, 1e51, 1e74 and 1e120. Piwu's guide gives 100b and 100Qa for levels 2 and 3, so check the in-game figure.
Level 4 is the last cheap step: level 5 costs twelve orders of magnitude more. Go past 4 only with spare sand.

A time-skip hourglass advances only the active character: combat, mining, woodcutting and ash per kill. It does not advance other characters, the Smeltery, Bonfire ash from fuel, the pet egg or curio coins. Boss chests hold one 1 time in 10.
From levels 12 and 16 the Hourglass talents also cost Act 3 wood and ore: about 280k wood and 550k ore to reach level 70 (a 700% bonus). Buy diamond upgrades top to bottom, left to right.

Rebirth rolls one Timeline Output or Sand item every 2 hours; 3 merge into 1 of the next tier (5 into 2 with the upgrade), in 9 slots that grow to 25. Secret Knowledge has up to 6 pages of up to 6 slots, and only the active page counts.
